name: Generative adversarial network
summary: Two networks that compete: one draws images and the other judges them as real or false, until the drawings pass.
how: Train a generator and a discriminator in turns on a large set of images.
Sample a latent vector of 512 numbers to draw one image.
Align the training faces so that the eyes sit at the same height in every image.
Expect small faults in teeth, ears, glasses and the background.

origin.note: Ian Goodfellow and co-authors publish the method in a paper in machine learning.

adoptions.via: NVIDIA releases StyleGAN; the next year a web page shows one new generated face on each reload.

sources.title: Goodfellow et al., Generative Adversarial Networks (2014)
